name: Sylas
notes: Hijack (R) is cast once at t=0 purely for the Unshackled stack it grants: against a stationary dummy there is no enemy ultimate to steal, so the dossier's open question on R's damage contribution is resolved by excluding it entirely.

Abscond and Abduct are modeled as a single instant E cast that lands Abduct's damage and its 0.25 s cast lockout, since Abscond itself never deals damage and both count as one activation against a target already in range.

Kingslayer is treated as having a genuine cast (using the numbers sheet's explicit castTime of 0.15 s and the resulting 0.25 s cast lockout) rather than the wiki's 'cast time: none', since the numbers sheet is the more literal source of Riot's data.

Unshackled's up-to-3 stacks and 4 s duration are modeled as one shared timer: any ability cast refreshes it to (current stacks + 1, capped at 3) with a fresh 4 s window, and a consumed stack removes one from the count without changing that shared expiry, approximating the wiki's per-stack timers and its 0.5 s attack-safety refresh rule.
The passive's 125% bonus attack speed is a flat buff active whenever at least one Unshackled stack is up, not a per-stack multiplier, matching the single PassiveAttackSpeed data value.

An empowered attack replaces that attack's normal physical damage with Petricite Burst's own magic damage to the primary target (130% AD + 30% AP); its reduced secondary-target AoE damage never triggers because a solo dummy fight has no secondary targets.

Petricite Burst's primary-target damage is allowed to critically strike using the build's actual crit chance and crit damage, rather than hard-coding the wiki-flagged 175%-instead-of-200% bug, since 175% is the current game's base crit multiplier anyway.

Chain Lash's initial chain hit and its 0.6 s-delayed explosion are dealt as two separate damage instances from the same cast; on-cast procs (Muramana, Eclipse, Spellblade) fire once, at the initial cast, not again on the delayed explosion.

Q, W and E are each cast as soon as they come off cooldown, with basic attacks filling every other moment; mana costs are not modeled since nothing here would actually run Sylas out of mana inside a 15 s level-16 fight.
